notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures that can attack this turn.
description:
Declare at least four creatures you control as attackers.
Holding priority, cast Dragonrage by paying {2}{R}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, copying Dragonrage.
Resolve the copy of Dragonrage, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.
